shipping.application: lince default ui with instinct,park in the Linux release recipe
shipping.interface: native-presentation, behavior-checks, activation, instinct and native-media through Park and the normal UI

conditional.application: Freedoom requires stuff, which the standard recipe leaves off. Provider, peer, hardware and diagnostics paths depend on runtime admission. Prepared test artifacts can expose a different feature set.

families.input: Native virtual and physical keyboard, pointer, touch, focus, IME, target validation and accessible activation
families.data: Ordered host/window events, input focus, current geometry, virtual accessibility tree and shortcut settings
families.update: Dispatch accepted actions, publish current selection/caret and accessible deltas, keep value widgets bound to their owner
families.workers: Clipboard and AT-SPI requests, ordered host queue, held-event validation and configured keyboard timing
families.persistence: Shortcut and widget settings use the workspace configuration. Text durability is owned by the edited document.
families.hidden: Keep modal/input cancellation and releases current. Hidden controls receive no new ordinary target input.
families.gap: Mixed physical input and real AT-SPI consumers need the physical route or a separately enabled helper.

families.input: Edit customization, per-item styling, font and layout fields and ordinary text controls
families.data: Layered style tokens, inherited roles, bundled fonts, authored text and per-item overrides
families.update: Resolve dirty branches and only changed paint, style and glyph geometry. Preserve current scale, clipping and contrast.
families.workers: Font/atlas realization and render extraction consume presented data. Complicated markup is owned by descriptions.
families.persistence: Style documents and native workspace item edits; appearance import/export keeps content separate.
families.hidden: Preserve logical style and text changes and prepare current visible glyphs on reveal.
families.gap: Current full-scene variant with global changes at both physical scales remains unverified.

families.input: Edit tabs, Store, placement, overview, pan, drag/resize, pin, groups and workspace transitions
families.data: Canonical workspace/desktop and hierarchy, actual output projections, saved placements and active focus
families.update: Resolve current native geometry, stack, modal and visibility ownership and retained toolbar and preview output
families.workers: Workspace writer and restoration, bounded preview construction, native scheduler wake on actual demand
families.persistence: Private workspace file, layouts, desktop focus, scratch, trash and owner settings
families.hidden: Retain intent, dirty edits and leases. Defer display-only publications and rebuild from current state on reveal.
families.gap: Physical workspace/output handoff and sustained drag cadence remain separate from the private fixture.

families.input: Area configure/draw, drag through boundaries, match and arm/disarm authoritative changes
families.data: Area geometry and settings, physics participants, eligible source match and current Record properties
families.update: Apply current forces and reach, settle, publish presentation effects, and send explicit entry/exit changes
families.workers: Cooling/physics schedule, live Protein matches and authorized mutation acknowledgements
families.persistence: Area settings and placement in workspace. Shared Record action ledger owns semantic property changes.
families.hidden: Keep enabled effects and armed crossing semantics. Quiet or disabled physics must give work back.
families.gap: Realistic population scaling of current physics and broad Area match changes need matched live observations.

families.input: Canvas/room/Terrain controls, drawing, appearance and independent render/capture consumers
families.data: Canvas/scene roots, 2D layout, 3D assets, retained image/mesh/style inputs and actual output geometry
families.update: Publish stable 2D/3D geometry and textures, resolve camera and output demand, prepare/extract/render only needed scenes
families.workers: Bevy and wgpu render phases, Vulkan completion/export, GLES import/application, asset prepare and pipeline acquisition
families.persistence: Scene definitions, placement and assets; render output and per-epoch leases remain transient.
families.hidden: Off-camera/inactive work depends on output, capture, overview and readiness. Preserve live identity and retirement.
families.gap: Physical per-output GPU and wait attribution and first real mixed-canvas startup remain unmeasured.

families.input: Record authoring, collaboration, configuration and Protein query/row/template controls with exact bound identities
families.data: Local or authorized Organ Cell rows, facts, canonical changes, collaboration documents and private draft journals
families.update: Deliver current affected query rows, refresh materialized projections and editor previews, update acknowledgement and retry status
families.workers: Subscriptions, journal writer and ordered actions, text joins and source retirement, backend authorization and invalidation
families.persistence: Exact canonical Record/Fact state and per-source pending journal. Projections and preview identities are separate.
families.hidden: Keep durable edits, valid semantic subscriptions and authority invalidation. Defer row building and detail paint.
families.gap: Run held-write and 20–30 item desktop acceptance with real edit/reply and publication costs.

families.input: Clock/timer and date controls, task or Kanban selection/move, Frequency and Calendar changes
families.data: Record log/Task state, schedule and current deadlines and isolated local timer configuration
families.update: Update due labels/maps/queue entries, time position and task status and visible history from current sources
families.workers: Explicit timer/recurrence deadlines, work logging, live query changes and waking time dependents
families.persistence: Task/order and bound timer changes are Record actions. Local timers and display choices are workspace state.
families.hidden: Continue required deadlines and action effects. Drop display-only queries and rows when source supports it.
families.gap: Hidden timer/recurrence combined with a prepared Karma rule is distinct from the private stopwatch and terminal.

families.input: Organ status, Sync source/target/retry, shared workspace and Transfer actions, backup, configuration and proposals
families.data: Current authorized runtime, component/feed identity, store transactions and peer/endpoint/directory snapshots
families.update: Publish bounded status/deltas, queue ordered action acknowledgements and apply authorized sync/transfer changes
families.workers: Cell reply lane, directory watcher, peer lifecycles, file/backup/Transfer jobs and status wakes
families.persistence: Private configuration, sync binding and journal, backups and canonical receipt/component history
families.hidden: Keep accepted durable jobs, deadlines and changes alive while presentation is absent. Retire stale sources.
families.gap: No current prepared same-scene physical attribution for real peer, directory-sync and backup workers. Do not enable peers for private fixtures.

families.input: Identity, authority, visibility and trust controls, source/Organ selection, map pan/pick and current location
families.data: Authorized graph/role/Record projections, map/assets and device position only when allowed
families.update: Maintain exact current rights/source/graph and present map/review/status views
families.workers: Scoped queries and graph/asset preparation, revocation and explicit hardware/provider requests
families.persistence: Canonical policies and ontology/identity facts. Workspace owns display and selection defaults.
families.hidden: Enforce rights and revocation even with closed views. Retire optional data requests or scene work without a consumer.
families.gap: The capture control proves epoch safety, not full role/identity/map rendering or external location performance.

families.input: Thread/member and message editors, completion/cancellation, Fiote setup and assistant actions
families.data: Authority-scoped threads, agent/assistant events, stable message IDs, attachment and selection state
families.update: Ordered stream/reply application, incremental signed history/attachment projections and current native status
families.workers: Private Cell and provider lanes, subprocess/agent session, voice/attachment work with explicit ownership
families.persistence: Thread messages and attachments, saved Fiote preferences, durable transmission state and recovery
families.hidden: Content can remain semantic during continued jobs. Stop or retire superseded sessions, cancel accepted work by owner.
families.gap: The native ordered-terminal control does not cover a simultaneous held Fiote stream. Any provider fixture must stay private and deterministic.

families.input: Prepare/inspect/run rules, optimization or simulation, preview side effects and stage accepted mutations
families.data: Scoped backend rule/event graph, action identity, deadlines, selected Record/source and proposed deltas
families.update: Continue semantic execution and publish current eligible status and bounded diagnostics to visible controls
families.workers: Rule evaluator/deadlines, action/execution lanes, simulation/optimization and success/error/retry
families.persistence: Canonical event/Fact and effect queue history, configured definitions and accepted simulation edits
families.hidden: Required rules and deadlines continue. Hideable status views cease unnecessary build work and replay checks authority.
families.gap: Same-scene with active due rules and mixed physical input has no recent shipping observation.

families.input: File explorer, URI/file drop, local document/source tabs, IDE edits and save/close/retry
families.data: Authorized scoped handles, local files, parser results, draft/base revisions and external disk changes
families.update: Open only current owner results, retain dirty text, show current selection/conflict and preview, publish save acknowledgement
families.workers: File open/read/parse and save worker, watcher, operator-initiated language tooling
families.persistence: Disk data and recovery checkpoint, session tabs and placement. Save commits only the applied revision.
families.hidden: Preserve in-flight work and draft recovery without unnecessary foreground layout. Cancel or retire stale view data.
families.gap: Combined heavy document preview, filesystem conflicts and external tooling need distinct authorized fixtures.

families.input: Rich-description mode and assets; playback/scrub; camera/audio/recorder and shader/scene choices
families.data: Approved local media, current source frames and retained textures, markup/shaders and audio device state
families.update: Decode/prepare and present demanded frames, accurate playback/recording state and visible privacy policy
families.workers: Native codec workers when compiled, external helpers/runtime hardware where authorized, texture uploads, audio/recording and readback
families.persistence: Explicit recordings and selected assets/files, workspace media settings and authoritative Record bodies
families.hidden: Keep required audio or recording alive. Cease video/upload/status work when privacy and all output/capture consumers allow.
families.gap: No private-frame case certifies real camera, audio or codec activity and the two-output browser workload.

families.input: Terminal focus, stdin and resize, Command run/stop/pause, history and live replay
families.data: Bound run/PTY and current focus, ordered byte/frame streams, saved Command Records and run journals
families.update: Preserve exact byte/order/exit state and publish current visible terminal text only when needed
families.workers: PTY and host process, terminal parse/libghostty, wake-driven journal/response and per-run cleanup
families.persistence: Canonical saved script, Command history and private tab layout; stream queues stay scoped to the run.
families.hidden: A held run survives closing its view and only foreground output follows demand. Retire views and stale stream owners.
families.gap: Actual concurrent byte-pressure and native input p95 in the installed Park session remain unmeasured.

families.input: Laboratory Run/Stop/Close, result import and isolated Instinct practice and prepared controls
families.data: Private workspace/Cell data, source rules, fixture selectors and bounded performance readings
families.update: Report cases and source identities, render private scenes, restore displaced workspace and focus on cancellation
families.workers: Selected test workers, practice seed and explicit snapshot/readback, opt-in host/system metrics
families.persistence: Exported findings and authorized practice state. Test workspace and course scratch have separate lifetimes.
families.hidden: Private selected checks may finish after UI retirement until cancelled; isolation and previous input state survive.
families.gap: Current report and observer instrumentation overhead awaits matched capture-off verification.

families.input: Wayland client keyboard/pointer/touch, window lifecycle, clipboard, lock and output management
families.data: Current surface, commit and output identities, actual mode/density/DRM devices and capture policy
families.update: Route current protocol and native surface geometry; compose/import and present expected frames per output
families.workers: Libinput, Wayland dispatch, Smithay/DRM, frame callbacks, GLES import/fences and client decoder/GPU
families.persistence: Output and desktop preferences in profile. Protocol grants and buffer/lock epochs never persist across connection owners.
families.hidden: Retire or release buffers/consumers; keep lock/capture privacy and required protocol progress even without native display damage.
families.gap: Two physical outputs, real Firefox decode-to-presentation and full-screen direct scanout await current measurements.

families.input: Freedoom start, focus, gameplay and exit
families.update: Expose current game view and its focused input and lifecycle
families.workers: Feature-gated game process and frame delivery
families.persistence: Workspace game placement/options and the external game data path
families.hidden: Keep explicit game semantics while focusing and follow ordinary app lifecycle on removal.
families.gap: Compiled out of standard Park. A start/focus/exit selector belongs to a separately enabled stuff artifact.
